about: The second head rests on the lines the lock's signers signed, in whatever ledger each landed and in whatever order: an unsigned line in a ledger is no part of what it attests.
Its word is read against the lock alone, never against what a place's own lock says for the tree.

cases.name: an owner ledger that also holds unsigned target lines, beside two lane ledgers
cases.restsOn: sha256 of the sorted set of the 3969 signed lines

red was: verify began to rest on the signed lines of every signer's ledger, and bound still digested every line of the owner's, so a fresh attestation read stale
